data.text/markdown:
FilmPulse

Weekly film campaign reporting

Track search interest, owned social performance, audience conversation, and practical actions for the next reporting period.

Data note: Demo data is synthetic. Replace it with your own CSV files or authorised platform exports before using the results for real decisions. Search interest is a relative index, not absolute search volume.
Reporting period

data.text/html: Using the project's configured datasets. Check the README for CSV formats.
